title: Astilbin from Smilax china L. remarkably inhibits LPS-induced endometritis in rats via blocking positive feedback between TLR4 and IL-6R signalling pathways in a PPAR-gamma-dependent manner.
authors: Feng, Haixing; Li, Chunni; Chen, Jingyao; Li, Zhiwen; Ye, Xuan; Hou, Lianbing; Wang, Chunxia; Hou, Chuqi; Liu, Wenqin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Astilbin通过PPAR-gamma依赖机制抑制LPS诱导的大鼠子宫内膜炎，虽含分子对接但核心是炎症信号通路与疾病治疗，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Astilbin (ATB), a natural flavonoid compound with anti-inflammatory bioactivities, can be isolated from Smilax china L., which has been used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat pelvic inflammatory disease (PID) (including endometritis). Our previous studies reported that flavonoids from Smilax china rhizome (FSCR) have therapeutic effects in rats with PID. However, the effects of ATB, the main active component of FSCR, against endometritis remain unknown. AIM OF THE STUDY: We aim to investigate the role of ATB on endometritis induced by lipopolysaccharide (LPS) in rats and elucidate the mechanisms underlying anti-inflammatory action of ATB on LPS-stimulated endometrial epithelial cells (EECs). METHODS: The effects and action mechanisms of ATB on LPS-induced endometritis in rats and LPS-induced EECs were systematically assessed using H&E staining, immunohistochemistry, ELISA, RT-PCR, western blotting, immunofluorescence, molecular docking and siRNA knockdown technology. RESULTS: ATB significantly alleviated typical uterine pathological damages in endometritis, decreased inflammatory cytokine levels in both serum and uterus, and also inhibited the excessive release of inflammatory cytokines in EECs induced by LPS. Mechanistically, ATB markedly upregulated PPAR-gamma levels and suppressed the overexpression of TLR4 and IL-6R proteins and their downstream signals, MyD88, and phosphorylation of NF-kappaB P65, JAK2, and STAT3, in vivo. Further, the effects of ATB on PPAR-gamma protein expression, and NF-kappaB and STAT3 signalling activation in LPS-induced EECs were consistent with the results of in vivo experiments. Furthermore, both PPAR-gamma-specific siRNA transfection and a selective PPAR-gamma antagonist abolished ATB-induced inhibition of NF-kappaB and STAT3 signalling activation and production of inflammatory cytokines. Molecular docking and in vitro experiments further proved that ATB can target PPAR-gamma binding. CONCLUSION: Overall, our results demonstrated that ATB can significantly inhibit endometritis in rats, presumably through interfering with NF-kappaB and STAT3 signal transduction in a PPAR-gamma-dependent manner, blocking the positive feedback between NF-kappaB and STAT3 signalling. Our findings provide new evidences for developing the ATB, the main compound identified from FSCR, as a potential therapeutic agent for endometritis.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：落新妇苷 (Astilbin, ATB) 是一种具有抗炎生物活性的天然黄酮类化合物，可从菝葜 (Smilax china L.) 中分离得到，该植物在传统中医中用于治疗盆腔炎性疾病 (PID)（包括子宫内膜炎）。我们先前的研究报道，菝葜根茎中的黄酮类化合物 (FSCR) 对大鼠PID具有治疗作用。然而，ATB作为FSCR的主要活性成分，其对子宫内膜炎的作用尚不清楚。研究目的：本研究旨在探讨ATB对脂多糖 (LPS) 诱导的大鼠子宫内膜炎的作用，并阐明ATB对LPS刺激的子宫内膜上皮细胞 (EECs) 抗炎作用的潜在机制。方法：通过H&E染色、免疫组织化学、ELISA、RT-PCR、western blotting、免疫荧光、分子对接和siRNA敲低技术，系统评估了ATB对LPS诱导的大鼠子宫内膜炎和LPS诱导的EECs的作用及作用机制。结果：ATB显著缓解了子宫内膜炎中典型的子宫病理损伤，降低了血清和子宫中的炎症细胞因子水平，并抑制了LPS诱导的EECs中炎症细胞因子的过度释放。机制上，ATB在体内显著上调PPAR-γ水平，并抑制TLR4和IL-6R蛋白及其下游信号MyD88、NF-κB P65、JAK2和STAT3磷酸化的过度表达。此外，ATB对LPS诱导的EECs中PPAR-γ蛋白表达以及NF-κB和STAT3信号激活的影响与体内实验结果一致。进一步，PPAR-γ特异性siRNA转染和选择性PPAR-γ拮抗剂均消除了ATB诱导的NF-κB和STAT3信号激活及炎症细胞因子产生的抑制作用。分子对接和体外实验进一步证明ATB可靶向结合PPAR-γ。结论：总体而言，我们的结果表明，ATB可显著抑制大鼠子宫内膜炎，推测其通过以PPAR-γ依赖性方式干扰NF-κB和STAT3信号转导，阻断NF-κB和STAT3信号之间的正反馈。我们的发现为开发ATB（从FSCR中鉴定的主要化合物）作为子宫内膜炎的潜在治疗药物提供了新证据。
